evidence: decorative_mascot: Data does not cause any motion: in hook@0.3–seg0:end he stands beside the scale pan holding a pole while bricks drop by themselves; in seg1:mid two Datas just stand by the rows; in seg3:mid/end he dangles off the 17% bar; in seg4 he stands on a ladder.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At payoff@-1.8 through seg4:end the label '2060 (projected) 17%' slides onto the same baseline as '2019 9%', so both become an illegible stack right on the payoff line. Data stands on a ladder doing nothing, and '8% apart' is really 8 percentage points.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The gap machine places the two endpoint labels at the same y with no collision check once the bracket spans both posts, and the mascot is parked instead of acting on the gap.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Put the 2019 9% and 2060 17% labels on their own posts at separate heights so they never overlap. Have Data physically do something to the gap, like climb and stretch the measuring tape from 9 to 17, and label it '8 points apart'.
